objective: Test whether executing the native layer-0 GDN prefill/cache transaction independently for each request, together with R88's qkvz split, restores strict c2 identity.

candidate.scope: Native XPU GDN calls containing more than one pure prefill request, no decodes, no speculative decodes, and no non-spec token remap. All other shapes use the existing single packed call.
candidate.implementation: Slice projected qkvz, BA, core output, z output, state index, initial-state flag, and query boundary per prefill request. Invoke the existing _xpu_C.gdn_attention operation with num_prefills=1 and natural token count for each request, retaining the shared cache tensors and scheduler order.
candidate.reason: R88 made both layer-0 projections exact across c1/c2, but layer-1 projections and the final c2 output still differed. The first remaining boundary is the layer-0 packed prefill/cache transaction or output projection.

fixed_workload.sequence: Run cache-c000 alone at c1, then cache-c000 plus index-c001 at c2 in the same fresh server.

followup_if_pass: Build a non-tracing production-lineage candidate, add an execution counter proving the intended branch ran, and run repeated c1/c2 plus the broader varied-prompt determinism/quality suite before any performance measurement. This diagnostic cannot promote speed.
followup_if_fail: Preserve the result and trace core_attn_out/z immediately after layer-0 GDN to distinguish native prefill output from the following norm/out projection.
promotion_boundary: Candidate only. No site, README, headline, protected-speed, recipe-default, or LocalMaxxing authority. This boot contains an earlier GPU reset.
